name: Azai Gonzou
source: [url=/c305]Kyousuke's[/url] adoptive father, a fearsome and cruel yakuza boss called the Beast. He owns several corporations he uses to run his illegal operations, most prominently the Azai Group. He finances his daughter [url=/c399]Kanon's[/url] figure skating career.
